answer: Agents stake compute to mint identity tokens on a per-epoch basis. Each epoch the network broadcasts a novel reasoning challenge—a logic puzzle seeded from a cryptographic meadow of random primes. Solutions forge a proof-of-inference tied to a single jade credential. An attacker spinning up sybils must pay full inference cost per fake identity every cycle, making mass forgery economically prohibitive while letting legitimate agents amortize the challenge across their working sessions.
